activities.name: Water Healing with Mayumi Yonamine
activities.description:
Guided by renowned wellness practitioner Mayumi Yonamine, this immersive WATSU® hydrotherapy experience combines gentle stretches and therapeutic touch in warm water. Designed to reduce stress, improve mobility, and restore balance, Water Healing promotes deep relaxation and a renewed sense of well-being.

Price: $450 USD (60 minutes) // $580 USD (90 minutes)

activities.name: Rest & Restore with Gyde Von Wlassack
activities.description:
Restore balance and resilience with renowned German therapist Gyde von Wlassack. Combining advanced neurophysiology with osteopathic techniques, her transformative approach helps regulate the nervous system, guiding the body from stress and fatigue into a deeper state of rest, recovery, and renewal.

Price: $450 USD (60 min) // $580 USD (90 min)

activities.name: Entre Tacos
activities.description:
Satiate your palette with an unlimited selection of gourmet tacos, salsas and garnishes. The mouthwatering experience is accentuated by the star-lit Baja skies paired with an acoustic musical performance and a selection of the best cocktails this side of the Sea of Cortez.

Price: $50 USD per person - Children (4-12): $25 USD

activities.name: Peninsula Nights
activities.description:
The rhythm of the night meets the flavors of Baja at Lucille’s Kitchen. Live music pairs perfectly with savory starters, premium cuts and the freshest Sea of Cortez flavors grilled to perfection and served family-style by Chef Carlos Grande, just as Lucille Bremmer did 70 years ago.

Price: $130 USD per person

activities.name: Pelican Beach Cabanas
activities.description: Mediterranean-inspired beachfront cabanas at our swimmable beach featuring a curated mezze selection, Veuve Clicquot Brut Champagne, personalized service, and views of the Sea of Cortez for a refined seaside escape.

activities.name: KidsOnly
activities.description:
Step into a vibrant space curated for children ages 4-11 to engage in creativity, play and discovery with and outdoor experiences. activities, kids are invited to partake in special weekly classes, including: 
Slime Making | $50+ USD
Huichol Art Class | $150+ USD 
Chocolate Workshop | $50+ USD
Meet Your Inner Artist | $150+ USD

activities.name: The Arroyo Course at Palmilla Golf Club (9 Holes)
activities.description:
Twisting its way through a calming desert landscape, this acclaimed ‘nine’, which can be looped for 18,
winds past giant centuries-old cardón cacti, juxtaposed against the sweeping Sea of Cortez vistas below. 

The course is home to native quails, roadrunners, and hawks, along with formidable doglegs and lengthy
forced carries, all which converge to create the most thrill-inducing 2.5 hours on the greens in all of Los Cabos.

Starting from: $240 USD per person

activities.name: Golf Pro Private Lessons
activities.description:
Range Lesson:
45-minute lesson focused on the short game, long game, or a combination of both.
Price: $200 USD + tax per person

Course Lesson:
2-hour playing lesson covering 9 holes, with a focus on course management, strategy, and on-course decision-making.
Price: $400 USD + tax per person

activities.name: Golf Play with a Pro
activities.description:
Designed for those who prefer to pair up rather than take a lesson, this unique experience offers the opportunity to discover the course through the eyes of an expert who knows every fairway, green, and hidden gem along the way.

9-Holes: $225+ USD per person

activities.name: Palmilla Social Brunch
activities.description:
Embark on a journey of flavors through Palmilla Social Club’s restaurants at Social Brunch. From Lucille’s Kitchen specialties to desserts from Lucille’s Café and cocktails at Sala 56, enjoy live music, family activities, interactive culinary stations, artisan products from Market del Tezal, and exclusive cocktails by Handshake, part of The World’s 50 Best Bars.

Price: $88 USD per person - Children (4-12): $44 USD - Children under 4 complimentary

activities.name: Mexico Magico
activities.description:
Immerse yourself in the spirit of Mexico through live entertainment, artisanal treasures, and authentic flavors. Celebrate culture and tradition beneath the Baja sky with regional specialties and handcrafted creations.

Price: Adults: $120 USD - Children (4-12): $60 USD

activities.name: Migrante Residency at Agua
activities.description:
Agua welcomes Migrante, the MICHELIN-recommended restaurant from Mexico City, led by Chef Fernando Martínez, Mexico’s Chef of the Year 2014 and coach of the Mexican national team at Bocuse d’Or Lyon 2023.

This distinctive culinary journey brings together Mexican heritage and global influences in an exceptional dining experience.
